references.text: The command to observe the Passover as a permanent statute for all generations, establishing the annual timing of the festival.
The instruction to keep the Passover ordinance as a lasting arrangement for the Israelites and their descendants.
The command to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread at the appointed time in the month of Abib, year after year.
The Israelites are to observe the Passover at the appointed time, on the fourteenth day of the month at twilight.
The instruction to keep the Passover in the month of Abib, confirming the annual celebration of the exodus from Egypt.
The earlier context in the same chapter describing the festival that is to be observed in the promised land.
Leviticus 23:41 specifies the annual festival observance required in Exodus 13:10 and uses identical language regarding a 'permanent statute'.
